PMDA-CT2001.Description: Raise an error when a non-empty value is not a term in the non-extensible CDISC controlled terminology codelist the CDISC Library defines for the variable. A variable must be populated with terms from its CDISC controlled-terminology codelist; new terms cannot be added to a non-extensible codelist.

Check.expression: var_codelist_extensible("LIBRARY") == false and not empty(var_codelist_coded_values("LIBRARY")) and not empty(value()) and value() not in var_codelist_coded_values("LIBRARY")

Outcome.Message: The value is not a term in the non-extensible CDISC controlled terminology codelist the CDISC Library defines for this variable.

PMDA-CT2002.Description: Raise an informational issue when a non-empty value is not a term in the extensible CDISC controlled terminology codelist the CDISC Library defines for the variable. A variable should be populated with terms from its CDISC codelist; because new terms may be added to an extensible codelist, a legitimately-added term is also flagged by this check.

Check.expression: var_codelist_extensible("LIBRARY") == true and not empty(var_codelist_coded_values("LIBRARY")) and not empty(value()) and value() not in var_codelist_coded_values("LIBRARY")

Outcome.Message: The value is not a term in the extensible CDISC controlled terminology codelist the CDISC Library defines for this variable; new terms may be added to an extensible codelist, so confirm the value is not a duplicate, synonym or subset of an existing standard term.

PMDA-CT2003.Description: Raise an error when a coded value and its paired decoded value do not map to the same term (Codelist Code) of the CDISC controlled terminology codelist the CDISC Library defines for the variable. Paired variables such as --TESTCD/--TEST must be populated with terms that share the same Codelist Code.

Outcome.Message: The coded value and its decode do not map to the same term of the CDISC controlled terminology codelist the CDISC Library defines for the paired variables.

PMDA-CT2004.Description: Raise an error when a populated value is not a term in the non-extensible codelist bound at the value level (Define-XML ValueListDef / WhereClauseDef) for the value-level condition that applies to the record.

Check.expression: not empty(value()) and vlm_codelist_extensible(variable_name) == false and vlm_has_codelist(variable_name) == true and value() not in vlm_codelist_coded_values(variable_name)

Outcome.Message: The value is not in the non-extensible value-level codelist declared in the Define-XML.

PMDA-CT2005.Description: Raise a warning when a populated value is not a term in the extensible codelist bound at the value level (Define-XML ValueListDef / WhereClauseDef) for the value-level condition that applies to the record.

Check.expression: not empty(value()) and vlm_codelist_extensible(variable_name) == true and vlm_has_codelist(variable_name) == true and value() not in vlm_codelist_coded_values(variable_name)

Outcome.Message: The value is not in the extensible value-level codelist declared in the Define-XML.
